## ⚙️ Run the Project Locally

### 1. Clone the repository

```bash
git clone YOUR_GITHUB_REPOSITORY_URL
```

### 2. Navigate into the project

```bash
cd Ram-Portfolio
```

### 3. Install dependencies

```bash
npm install
```

### 4. Start the development server

```bash
npm run dev
```

Vite will normally display a URL similar to:

```text
http://localhost:5173/
```

Open that URL in your browser.

---

## 📱 Open the Website on Another Device

To access the development website from your phone or another computer on the same Wi-Fi network, run:

```bash
npm run dev -- --host
```

Vite will display a **Network** URL similar to:

```text
http://192.168.x.x:5173/
```

Open that **Network URL** on your mobile device.

> **Note:** `localhost` refers to the device running the development server, so `http://localhost:5173/` should not be used on another device.

## 🚀 Deployment

The portfolio can be deployed using platforms such as **Vercel** or **Netlify**.

For a Vercel deployment:

1. Push the project to GitHub.
2. Import the repository into Vercel.
3. Select the project.
4. Configure the build settings if required.
5. Deploy the application.

After deployment, every new push to the connected branch can trigger a new deployment automatically.

---

## 🔄 Updating the Portfolio

After making changes to the project:

```bash
git status
git add .
git commit -m "Update portfolio"
git push
```

If your repository is connected to Vercel or another CI/CD platform, the new version can then be deployed automatically.
